images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Real-time strategy seen from the top gallery of a lighthouse on a stormy night: the camera looks down and out over a dark churning sea toward a low horizon of storm clouds. At the bottom center the curved iron railing and the top of a brass Fresnel lens glowing warm white. One huge wedge-shaped light beam sweeps across the water, turning the waves under it silver-white and lighting slanted rain streaks; everything outside the beam is near-black teal. Black jagged reefs ringed with white foam scattered across the sea. Three small steamships with red and green navigation lights: the one inside the beam is brightly lit, the other two are dim silhouettes in darkness with dotted route lines toward a small harbor with a green and a red breakwater lamp on the left headland. Floating ship callout cards with small risk bars. Right side: a brass-trimmed control console with a rotation-speed dial, three glass color-filter discs (white, red, green), a round brass foghorn button, and a vertical oil tank at 38%. Top HUD: '폭풍의 등대지기', '제3야', amber clock '02:47', label '빛 안'. Painterly semi-realistic, storm-noir palette of deep teal-black, cold white beam, sodium amber and brass, film grain, heavy vignette.

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same lighthouse-top view at the peak of the storm: rain is much heavier, a jagged white lightning bolt splits the purple-black sky at the horizon, and the lighthouse beam has shrunk to a thin, flickering orange-red sliver because the oil is almost gone. In the middle distance a small passenger steamer is tilted and wrecked on a reef, its hull tinted red by a hanging red distress flare with drifting smoke; spray bursts around it. Far right a tiny fishing boat with one blinking masthead light is barely visible in the dark, just outside the weak beam. On the left, inside the harbor breakwater, a third ship sits safe. A dark red banner across the top center reads '기름 4%'. The brass console on the right shows the oil tank almost empty with a flashing red rim, a tally row '입항 1 · 좌초 1 · 어둠 속 1', and three choice buttons, the first highlighted '회전 정지 — 동백에 빛을 고정'. Amber-red clock '04:12'. Painterly semi-realistic, desperate mood, ember orange and flare red against storm blue-black, film grain, heavy vignette.
